new_page.title: Surrey Penthouses for Sale | Prices and Buildings
new_page.description: Search Surrey penthouses for sale. 46 sold over the past ten months at a median of $465,000, with prices by neighbourhood and the buildings that sell most.

faq.q: How much does a penthouse cost in Surrey?
faq.a: The 46 penthouses that closed between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026 had a median of $465,000, with the middle half between $390,000 and $544,500. All Surrey condos had a median of $439,900.

faq.q: How does a Surrey penthouse compare in price with other condos?
faq.a: A penthouse cost 6% more at the median, or $593 a square foot against $630 for all condos. Compare the floor area, the strata fee and the roof or terrace before you decide.

faq.q: How fast do Surrey penthouses sell?
faq.a: 32 days at a median, closing at 96.6% of list, with 7% over the list price.

faq.q: What counts as a penthouse in Surrey?
faq.a: 46 of the 747 Surrey condo sales carried Penthouse in the style field, most of them in Whalley (22 sales). The listing agent enters that, so some top-floor homes are unmarked and a marked one is not always on the very top floor.

faq.q: Do Surrey penthouses have higher strata fees?
faq.a: The median strata fee was $425 a month for penthouses and $396 for all condos.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Sold figures come from Paragon closed sales to August 31, 2026, because the export is incomplete after that. The live search is not connected yet.

This search lists penthouses for sale in Surrey and North Surrey: top-floor condos that the listing marks as a penthouse. It covers Surrey City Centre, Guildford, Fleetwood and Newton. Other condos, townhomes and houses are separate searches.

46 Surrey penthouses closed from November 1, 2025 to August 31, 2026, out of 747 condo sales in the same area and months. The median penthouse sold for $465,000, 6% more than the $439,900 median for all condos, in 32 days at a median.

About buying a top-floor home in Surrey
For 2026 Surrey’s residential property tax rate is $3.42731 per $1,000 of assessed value. The Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 21900, was adopted on June 15, 2026.
Before you offer on a Surrey penthouse

items.t: Check the strata’s contingency reserve fund against the roof’s age. The depreciation report is where the next replacement is costed.
Check the Form B information certificate for claims, special levies and the insurance deductible before you remove subjects.
Find out who pays to repair the terrace membrane. The answer follows from whether the space is owned, limited common property or common property.
Ask what sits on the roof above the unit, such as rooftop equipment or an elevator housing, and listen for it at night.

Compare the building’s fee with the $425 a month median for Surrey penthouses and $396 for all condos. A fee well above that deserves a look at what it covers. The median Surrey penthouse sold was built in 2011.
